name: chillon-castle
documented_evidence: Chillon Foundation explicitly gives an approximately100x50m oval rocky island, three main courtyards, a square central keep, north defensive facade and south/lakeside residential facade with Gothic windows.
modeling_qualifications: Keep roof25m and range heights are approximate; island scale uses official dimensions and production footprint. Heading346deg follows north/south island axis. Source lake surface is371m; castle anchor372m. Mesh adds no lake plane. Source bridge alignment needs final world review. Ownership includes all22 separately mapped castle ranges, towers and gates on the island; the central keep way alone is not the entire castle multipolygon. Mainland visitor buildings remain native.
attribution: Original procedural metric mesh; no downloaded mesh or photo textures. Map ring evidence: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), via Protomaps. Operator texts/images are referenced, not redistributed.
review_status: Final actual-engine capture reviewed on9a4cdd0214ef38fe6cd7daa0d78ed55d03ae26f7a8a14185e5d0c3be7eaf15b5. Complete mapped ownership removes duplicate source ranges, while mainland buildings and lake remain; no obvious source overlap or buried/flooded base.
